subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: enrolment required Berlin ARDS. obese_population: mean BMI 33 (± 7) kg/m2 ≥ 30. timing_subgroup: PEEP trials initiated at a median of 1 day [0–3] after intubation, i.e. mostly within 48 h of the reference event (intubation), though the IQR extends to 3 days. ptp_target_subgroups: the study applies the positive end-expiratory PL,EE target (absolute Pes subtraction); the EIT-based methods do not use transpulmonary pressure targets. Note: the study was excluded at eligibility (balloon did not guide delivered PEEP), so subgroup flags are recorded for completeness only.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No trial registration number is reported for this analysis. Enrolment windows and centres: Erasmus MC, Rotterdam, March-October 2020 and Maasstad Hospital, Rotterdam, March-December 2021. The report states that data from part of the first cohort were presented earlier in refs [22] van der Zee 2020 (Am J Respir Crit Care Med) and [23] Somhorst 2022 (Crit Care); neither reference is listed in studies/COHORTS.md, and the cluster list there (epvent1, epvent2, mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, angers) does not match this report's centres, registration or enrolment dates, so no overlapping record in this review was identified and no cohort_id was assigned. If the van der Zee 2020 or Somhorst 2022 reports are found in the full candidate pool, this record should be re-checked against them for partial patient overlap.
unclear_items: eligibility.criteria.balloon_guided_peep_titration: an explicit rule linking Pes to PEEP exists ('Positive PL,EE: we selected the lowest PEEP level yielding a PL,EE at or just above 0 cmH2O'), but the report never states that the P_L,EE-recommended PEEP was actually used to change these patients' ventilator settings; the PEEP trial itself followed a fixed decremental protocol and the paper calls itself a physiological study without treatment effects. Coded 'yes' on the presence of a Pes-based PEEP selection rule.

arms: the seven PEEP-setting methods are alternative analyses of the same decremental PEEP trial rather than conditions applied one after another; sequence_position and comparator.crossover_order are therefore null and the within-patient structure is data-level, not time-level.

outcomes[].data for 'Amount of collapse', arm positive_pl_ee: the value 5.4 [2.0-12.0] % is attributed in the text to 'estimated marginal means' while the paper's stated convention is median [1st quartile-3rd quartile]; recorded as median with IQR.
outcomes[].data for 'Recommended PEEP': numeric values for EIT_ACP, EIT_LC and Highest CRS are not given in the text and appear only in Figure 2 (and Table S3, supplement not supplied).
domain for the EIT-derived 'overdistension' and 'collapse' outcomes: no domain matches exactly; coded as lung_volume (regional aeration), but respiratory_mechanics or other could be argued.

design.consecutive_enrolment: the report states that all clinically performed EIT-based PEEP trials during the study period were reviewed (65 in total) and 29 patients included, but does not state whether inclusion was consecutive.
arms cov_50 and vd_ratio_1, n_analysed: the number of patients contributing to the CoV and V/D-ratio endpoints is not reported (CoV was not available from online EIT results for some patients).

population.exclusion_criteria: the paper gives no formal exclusion list; the only exclusion statement is in the Discussion (patients excluded after review for insufficient data quality), which is recorded verbatim there.
design.randomised: coded false as the analysis is explicitly a post-hoc retrospective physiological comparison; no randomisation of methods is described.

extraction_flags.general_notes: This is a post-hoc physiological comparison of PEEP-setting methods, not a clinical-outcome study: no mortality, ventilator-free days, length of stay or other patient-centred outcome is reported. The report is a post-hoc analysis of patients from two Dutch cohorts, part of which was published earlier (refs 22 and 23). Additional file 1 (Tables S2-S3, Figures S2-S4) was not provided with the review material, so several per-method endpoint values remain available only as figures. Some patients underwent multiple PEEP trials during their ICU admission; only the first PEEP trial during controlled ventilation in supine position was analysed, so arms here are analytic conditions of that single trial rather than a sequence of applied strategies.
